prs.aboutDevelopment: Renting an apartment with Occu is how renting should have always been. No fuss, no faff and next-level service.

description:
Charming 1, 2 and 3 Bed apartments available to rent in Killester. 

Occupying an exceptional setting, right next to Clontarf and Killester Village, Occu Brookwood is superbly located only a 5-minute walk from the nearest Dart station. The area offers a great selection of trendy bars, restaurants, and shops, as well as plenty of other activities and amenities close by for you to explore!

Raised from a restored convent, this exceptional development is set across four buildings and is full of character inside and out. Each apartment across both the beautiful period building, and stylish new builds has been finished to the highest standards and fitted out in signature Occu style. Enjoy bright open-plan living spaces, excellent finished and considered design that will help you feel at home right away. 

Standard features of Occu Brookwood apartments include:
- Bespoke, designer furniture packages 
- A-Rated appliances 
- Plenty of storage space 
- Heating and hot water is provided by the latest Dimplex air source heat pump and electric radiator systems, meaning there is just one energy bill! 

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!). 
Better Renting. That's different. 

Please note: BER's range from A2-A3 
Please note, photos may not be specific to each available apartment, but all apartments are finished to similar standard.
